heading: top-left
name: 四欄圖片卡片網格＋置中按鈕（手機改橫向滑動）
desc: 標題靠左、下方一列等寬等高的圖片卡片，最下方置中一顆按鈕；手機改成一次一張的橫向滑動並有左右箭頭。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組只有標題（可多行），不放小標籤與說明文字。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機一列四個，項目等寬、同一列等高。每個項目是一張只有底色、沒有外框線的卡片：橫式圖片在上，圖片貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側，所有圖片同一比例，圖片約佔卡片高度三分之一，圖片左上角可疊一個小標籤；圖片下方的文字區靠左、靠上排列：每張卡片的結構固定相同，依序是一個外框小標籤、標題（可多行），以及兩組資料列，每組是上方一個小字次要標籤加下方一段次要文字；卡片等高時文字區下方留空。網格下方置中放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 標題組改為置中。網格改為橫向滑動，一次顯示一張卡片，右緣露出下一張卡片的一部分；整個輪播只有左右各一個圓形箭頭按鈕，疊在卡片的左右緣上，點擊切換上一張與下一張，也可左右滑動；在第一張時左箭頭淡化。卡片內部結構不變。按鈕仍置中放在卡片下方。

en.name: Four-column image card grid with centered button (carousel on mobile)
en.desc: A left-aligned title above one row of equal-width, equal-height image cards, with a centered button at the bottom; on mobile it becomes a one-card-at-a-time carousel with left and right arrows.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains only a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with no label or description. Below the heading group, multiple items form a grid aligned to the page content width, four per row on desktop, with items of equal width and equal height within a row. Each item is a card with only a background fill and no outline: a landscape image on top, flush with the top edge and both sides of the card, all images in the same proportion, the image taking about one third of the card height, and a label may overlay the top-left corner of the image; below the image, the text area is aligned left and to the top: every card has the same fixed structure: an outlined label, a title (may wrap to multiple lines), and two data rows, each a small secondary label above a piece of secondary text; when cards are equal height, the space below the text area stays empty. Below the grid, place one centered button; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: The heading group becomes centered. The grid becomes a horizontal carousel showing one card at a time, with part of the next card visible at the right edge; the whole carousel has just one circular arrow button on each side, overlapping the left and right edges of the card; tapping switches to the previous or next card, and swiping left and right also works; on the first card the left arrow is dimmed. The inner structure of the cards stays the same. The button stays centered below the cards.
